title: The buddy's buttons — round two for Open and Hide

steps.path: The button row beside the buddy, third button
steps.headline: Which picture best says "open the full YouCoded window"?
steps.notice: Your two favourites from last round come first, then four new mixes of them. The first button now shows the screen-with-corners picture you chose.

variants.label: Open elsewhere
variants.summary: Last round's B: a box with an arrow leaving it.

variants.label: App window
variants.summary: Last round's C: a plain window with a title bar.

variants.label: Window, arrow out
variants.summary: The app window's title bar, with the arrow leaving through its corner. B and C in one.

variants.label: Window, arrow inside
variants.summary: The app window with a small arrow inside pointing up and out.
variants.risk: The arrow is small at real size.

variants.label: Window, arrow up
variants.summary: The app window with an arrow rising inside it: "bring the window up".

variants.label: Softer open
variants.summary: B again, with a rounder box set lower so the arrow stands clear of it.

steps.path: The button row beside the buddy, last button
steps.headline: Which picture best says "hide the buddy until I bring him back"?
steps.notice: Four new ideas; no eyes, arrows-down or crosses. Hiding puts him away until the app restarts or you switch him back on in Settings.

variants.label: Sleep
variants.summary: A moon with a small z: put him to sleep. Friendly, and fits a companion who comes back later.

variants.label: Step out
variants.summary: An arrow leaving through a doorway: he steps out.
variants.risk: The same picture often means "sign out".

variants.label: Minimise
variants.summary: A box with a single line, like a window's minimise button.
variants.risk: Could read as "make the chat smaller".

variants.label: Put in tray
variants.summary: An arrow going down into an open tray: put him away in a drawer.
variants.risk: Close to the usual "download" or "save" picture.
